categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies `txdownloadman_impl.cpp` handling the compact block extrapool cache.
categories.rationale: Prevents consensus-invalid transactions from occupying space in the compact block extrapool cache. As noted in the PR description, extrapool entries assist in reconstructing compact blocks, and transactions rejected with TX_CONSENSUS 'are not useful to reconstruct consensus valid blocks.'
